scope: Original c=1 one-coordinate continuous Levy density, diagonal r,L chain. Three deterministic quadrature rounds are diagnostics, not certified intervals or actual geom pressure.
analytic_candidate_before_run: dr/dlogL >= 2r(1-r) makes the original Levy measure derivative nonnegative; odds(r)=C L^2 gives finite-step measure order.
s_map: s=1+t/(1-t), t in (0,1), Gauss-Legendre; s tail is transformed, not truncated.
x_grid: zero plus geomspace(1e-6,1,x_nodes-1), even negative part integrated on [-1,1]; analytical H>=0 for |x|>=1 at every nonnegative slope.
finite_difference_negative_part_scope: Only registered x in [0,1] and their negatives; unlike generator, finite difference tail outside this interval not certified numerically.
original_Ga_validation: Spectral rho_a formula integrated against 2s/(s^2+xi^2), xi=0,.5,2,8, compared with exact original symbol; closed a-integrated phase checked against independent Gauss a integration at s=1.0001,1.1,2,8.
metrics: closed phase vs nested a quadrature
profiles: Save all x,generator,finite-step profiles with file hashes. No clipping negative values.
seeds: None: deterministic quadrature only. No independent random validation claimed.
confidence: No probabilistic CI or numerical certification. Refinement differences are not rigorous error bars. General positivity is established analytically separately.
stop_rule: Finish these bounded rounds and analytic derivation; no full-rank MC, no old data rerun, no adaptive slope tuning.
actual_interface_limit: One diagonal curve does not cover the full two-parameter receiver family for free; a foliation does not share one stopping-source budget automatically. No full FIRST/CP/GP or actual geom estimate is claimed.
